name: Priest
lore: Master of Holy Light and Shadow madness: protect yourself with sacred Power Word shields, or enter Shadowform to siphon life from enemies.

resource.name: Shadowform
resource.tip: Toggle between Holy and Shadow. In Shadowform, Shadow spells cost less and hit harder, while Holy spells cost more.
resource.rules: Toggle into Shadowform to reduce dark spell costs and siphon health from enemies. Drop out of Shadowform when you need pure Holy protection and restorative healing.

archetypes.name: Discipline
archetypes.text: Shields, wards and energy tricks; Power Infusion and Mana Burn keep you ahead of the curve.

archetypes.name: Holy
archetypes.text: Big heals, Renew and Lightwell regen, with Smite and Holy Nova to close fights.

archetypes.name: Shadow
archetypes.text: Enter Shadowform, stack DoTs and drain life with Vampiric Embrace.

relics.name: Benediction
relics.text: Start each combat with 2 Regen for 5 turns. Holy cards deal 2 extra damage.

relics.name: Eye of the Dead
relics.text: Whenever you play a shadow card, gain 2 Block.

spellIdSource: Classic rank-1 ids from memory (unverified; DB confirmed only Fireball 133 in datamine). Spirit of Redemption has null (racial passive).
notes: formCost: card-level {"shadowform": n}. Engine adds n to the card's energy cost while form == shadowform (min 0). Shadow cards -1, holy cards +1.
Shadowform card toggles: set_form shadowform when not active, set_form none when active.
NEW status vampiric_embrace (kind buff, intensity): after you deal shadow damage, heal 25% of it per stack (rounded down, min 1). Hook in status.js.
Mind Control: `taunted` applied to an ENEMY means its attacks target another enemy instead of the player for the duration (alone: the attack is wasted).
revive pct on a power card arms a once-per-combat revive; the heal after it is applied on revive.
target_is_family takes `family` (string or array). enemy_intent takes `intent` (e.g. cast). chance uses `pct`. hp_below_pct uses `pct` on the actor (add "target":"enemy" for the foe).
school_last: true when the last card played this combat had the given school (relic triggers).
Statuses used: regen poison burn slow weak curse stealth fear silence stun disease taunted armor thorns dexterity frail vulnerable strength.
